niche: a UK job board's monthly restart-your-alerts email to jobseekers whose daily job alerts were paused for inactivity, piloted April to September 2026 with a random tenth held out, judged for 2027 on the sponsored clicks employers pay for
analyst_test: A strong analyst who maps every address to its mailbox provider, removes scanner clicks and reads the pilot's random holdout correctly measures the restart email's uplift on the restored jobseekers' sponsored clicks, carries it to the twelve 2027 sends and files a gain of about two hundred thousand clicks a year, missing that each send cut the active jobseekers' clicks at three mailbox providers for about ten days.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the series' net incremental sponsored clicks, the randomised holdout uplift among the jobseekers it re-engages less the clicks the job board loses while mailbox providers filter its daily alerts to everyone else after each send, an interference the experimentation field measures by provider against the send dates; put a hospital or a utility in its place and there is no marketplace whose paying clicks ride on one shared alert stream, so the call stops making sense.
layer1: two email platforms either side of the March 2025 migration, with different event names, provider groupings and a UTC clock against the billing system's UK local time

world.org_type: an online job board paid by employers per click on sponsored jobs

driver: A programme's yield is measured by a randomised holdout inside the group it targets, but every message the organisation sends shares one standing with the services that deliver it, and the targeted group's stale addresses lower that standing for every recipient for some days after each send, so the regular messages to the members outside the test reach fewer of them and the business loses part of what they would have bought; the holdout cannot see it because both its arms share the standing, and only the outside members' purchases, read by delivering service against the send dates and net of what they bought by other routes, show what each send costs.
driver_concrete: Each monthly restart-your-alerts send to Quaywork's paused jobseekers hits recycled addresses at the Google, Microsoft and Yahoo mailboxes, which then file Quaywork's daily job alerts to every active jobseeker there as junk for about ten days, so the pilot's holdout uplift (restored jobseekers' sponsored clicks) has to be netted against the active jobseekers' sponsored clicks lost at those three providers in each send's window, read against the unaffected providers and net of the clicks they made on the site and app instead.
stump: A competent analyst reads the pilot's random tenth holdout, measures about nineteen thousand extra sponsored clicks per send from the jobseekers the email restored, carries it to the twelve 2027 sends and recommends keeping the series for about 230,000 clicks a year; the step that lands it there is treating the holdout difference as the series' whole effect, when each send cost the active jobseekers at Google, Microsoft and Yahoo addresses more sponsored clicks than it restored, so the series loses the job board clicks and should stop.

differentiation.task118: task118's second architecture discounts an item's measured gain by the share taken from items shown beside it on one display (diversion of demand); here nothing is diverted: the targeted sends degrade the delivery of every other message through the senders' shared standing with the mailbox providers, and the loss is read on the untargeted members by provider against the send dates.
differentiation.task184: task184's first architecture rebuilds both arms of a site's difference because the filed plan is not the untreated arm; here the randomised holdout is a correct untreated arm for the targeted group, and the missing piece is a loss outside the experiment, among members the series never mails.
differentiation.task472: task472's first architecture prices a stoppage by how far it pushes the slowest of several parallel streams; here there is no completion time, only a programme's effect on the messages of members outside its test through a shared delivery standing.

lineage.architecture: v11 (Brenmoor leak-detection grant at Pellow Living's April 2027 renewal, actuarial-science-insurance pricing-ratemaking-credibility, Opportunity Sizing)
lineage.niche: a specialist property insurer's 1 April 2027 renewal of a build-to-rent landlord's portfolio buildings policy, choosing which leak-detection programme on the renewal shortlist (a list of flats each fitted with an automatic shut-off detector) it funds as a risk-improvement grant, sized as the escape-of-water claims cost the detectors would have prevented over the three policy years to 31 March 2026, when an escape that starts under one flat's floor is claimed in the flats beneath and the landlord's repairs log is the one record of where each escape was stopped
lineage.layer2_pattern: own:escape-of-water loss booked to the flat where the escape started
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what fitting a preventer to a set of units removes from a loss that each event records at every unit it damages, when an event that starts at one unit runs on into the units beneath it and often leaves its own unit without a record; the loss records show where damage arrived, not where events began, so the units that record the most are the ones beneath the sources, and only a second system's record of where each event was stopped, matched to the losses by place and day, shows which units start them.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each programme is sized as the escape-of-water claims cost of the escapes that started in its flats over the three policy years; the 2017 to 2019 void-turnover refits put integrated washing machines in floor-level cupboards whose leaks run under the floor and come through the ceiling below, so those flats rarely claim while the flats beneath them claim again and again, and only the plumber's leak repair in the landlord's repairs log, matched to the claims by building, stack and day, shows the escapes started in the refitted flats.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst books each escape-of-water claim to the flat that made it, or groups each block, stack and day's claims under the highest flat that claimed, and funds LD3, the galvanised pipework blocks from the second floor up (GBP 582,000 or 629,000); but the 2017-19 refits' floor-cupboard washing machines leak under the floor into the flat below while the refitted flat rarely claims, so only the plumber's leak repair in Pellow's repairs log, a floor above the claims on the same day, shows those escapes started in the refitted flats, and traced there LD2 would have prevented GBP 727,000 against LD3's 471,000.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-02 at stage 4: the determinism judge returned NOT_DETERMINISTIC, SEND_BACK on Gate H3 (rule application): the fund terms had to file the population as escapes from the water supply of a listed flat, whichever flats the water damaged, which stated the attribution the decisive step turned on, and one join on block, stack and date of loss then found every source; the leak reader named the same sentence; the storm asks also forked on an unfiled re-dating rule (fork-is-the-stump, lesson 10)

lineage.architecture: v10 (Copsewell Cross losses reconductoring, energy-systems-utilities asset-condition-maintenance, Opportunity Sizing)
lineage.niche: a distribution network operator's 2027/28 losses programme choosing which of eight 11 kV feeders out of one primary substation gets its old-conductor sections replaced, each project sized as the I2R technical losses the new conductor would have removed on the 2025/26 half-hourly flows, when a solar farm at the far end of one feeder exports back through its old overhead sections to an industrial estate near the primary
lineage.layer2_pattern: own:section net flows with embedded generation
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what replacing part of a branching line removes from a loss that grows with the square of the flow through that part, when flow is metered only at the line's source and at each draw-off point and a large injection near the line's end sends flow back through the replaced part toward draw-offs near the source; the source meter nets the injection against those draw-offs and the draw-off meters never see it, so the flow through each part has to be rebuilt period by period as the net of every draw-off and injection beyond it, and the line whose source reading looks quietest carries the largest flows where it is replaced.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each project's saving is the I2R loss its new conductor removes on the sections it replaces over 2025/26's half-hours; the Hob Moor solar farm exports up to 5 MW back along Kestle feeder's old 0.1 sq in copper overhead sections to the Kestle Park estate near Copsewell Cross primary, so the feeder-head SCADA shows only the estate's daytime load net of the export and the substation monitors show only their own loads, and rebuilt half-hour by half-hour as the net of every substation's flow and every generator's export beyond each section, Kestle's project removes the most losses.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst carries each feeder's metered head current through the sections its project replaces and files Oxenford Lane at 558.2 MWh a year, whose old overhead line is charged with a current it never carries; rebuilt from the loads beyond each section the flows pick Copsewell Town at 48.2; only the net of every load and generator beyond each section, the Hob Moor Solar Park's export included, puts Kestle first at 74.2.
lineage.fate: delivered 2026-10-28 (portal result pending; the delivered version stays on the portal as delivered). The main call held at the in-house judge (DETERMINISTIC, APPROVE, pass 10), but the 2026-11-01 honest-cracker audit measured the ask layer spent (the careful cracker keeps 16 of 16 device figures, 36 of 36 ask criteria against the recorded 20, pair 69.8), and the full replacement screened on 2026-11-02 found no record in that world that could carry a passing device: the outage record's devices were spent and every other record type was contradicted by the frozen flows or empty in them. Re-rooted to architecture 11 on 2026-11-02 in another client domain, world, dataset, generator and shell.

lineage.layer2_pattern: own:concordance by distribution matching, not regression
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many units fall below a cut on a new instrument's scale when part of the population was measured only on the old instrument; a sample measured on both links the scales, and predicting each unit's new value by regression shrinks every converted value toward the sample's mean, so the converted spread is too narrow and the tail beyond the cut too thin, while matching the percentiles of two groups each measured on one instrument assumes the groups are alike; only a conversion that matches the two instruments' distributions in the sample measured on both keeps the share beyond the cut.
lineage.fate: spent on the portal 2026-10-27: both responses landed the call and one filed the runner-up and the gap exactly; the decisive step was the field's own named method for the deciding quantity, so no competent reflex was stopped by it

lineage.layer2_pattern: own:weather-normalized emissions on the current operating regime
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each unit's output in a standard year of an external driver as the unit now operates, estimated from a response model fitted on the unit's own record; partway through the record many units changed how they respond to the driver or how much they draw regardless of it, on dates no file records, so a model fitted over the whole record or over the latest twelve months, or one recent year scaled by the driver's ratio, misstates the units whose response changed or whose fixed draw does not scale, and each moves a different set of units across the cap.
lineage.fate: judge SEND_BACK 2026-10-17 (NOT_DETERMINISTIC: the post-change window's first span and whether electricity is refit with the heating fuel unforced)

spent 2026-10-27 at the stage 4 re-judge on Gate C, and its world then measured closed; architecture 4 screened the author's fixed education-and-ETL pairing and refused all four candidate decisive steps on measured arithmetic; architecture 5 screened all six ETL cells in the taxonomy and refused or barred every one, which closed the ETL objective for this number
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how much a set of units can deliver in a forward period, and each unit's deliverable positions are fewer than the positions it reports because some of them cannot be worked at the same time, a ceiling no file states and no attestation reflects; the ceiling is fixed exactly by the greatest number of the unit's own timed service intervals that have ever run together, repeated in every period of a long record, so multiplying reported positions by staffed sessions overstates the total and overstates it most at the units whose ceiling is lowest.

lineage.architecture: v6 (Thornmere adult skills place slate, education x experiment-causal)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-28 at stage 3 before the documents or asks were cut. Measured twice: as a measurement of the closed intakes the decisive step was a denominator choice, which collapses to execution once the estimand is filed literally (rule 3); as a forward call the hardening failed the margin floor, best 1.182 against 1.15 over 900,000 draws and every allocation from 4,500 to 20,000 places. Architecture 7's two candidates were also refused, attenuation on task249's reader having landed it and the winner's curse on the one-knob argument.
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what one funded unit delivers, where the buyer commits the unit before the recipient decides and a refused unit can be passed on only until a fixed calendar date closes the cycle, so the share of funded units ever taken up runs from under a half to nearly all across the candidates; an effect estimated per unit taken up, however cleanly identified from the random rationing, ranks the candidates by their effect on a recipient rather than by what the buyer's committed unit returns.

lineage.niche: an adult education service's withdrawal review: the composition of reasons behind the 2025/26 withdrawals, coded from learners' own free-text exit comments, with the moderation return the service draws each year by reason code (every OT, 400 of each other code)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how a population divides between categories that are only ever observed through a classification that is right at different rates for different categories, so a category whose members describe themselves obliquely is under-counted while the category their words get read as is over-counted; counting the assigned labels ranks the categories by how legible they are rather than by how common they are, and only inverting the per-category hit rates measured on a re-classified sample recovers the division the decision needs.
lineage.driver_concrete: Caring-role withdrawals reach the record as sentences about hours ('nobody to sit with mum on thursday so i cant be there for the start'), so the coding manual's caring-role category is recognised in 68 of 100 cases while work hours clash is recognised in 90 and absorbs the spill. Raw coded counts put work hours clash at 24.5 per cent and caring role at 20.1; carrying the moderation return's split behind each code onto the coded counts puts caring role at 25.4 and work hours clash at 20.2, so the 2027 retention budget targets the other reason.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst counts the coded reasons and commits the 2027 retention budget to work hours clash at 24.5 per cent of withdrawals, because the coded counts measure which reasons the coders recognise rather than which reasons learners had; reweighting the coded counts by what the service's own moderation return measures behind each code puts caring role first at 25.4 per cent against work hours clash at 20.2.

lineage.architecture: v9 (pharmacology medication-adherence-persistence, Descriptive & Distribution: a PCN placing statin continuity sessions on the expected number of patients with no statin issued March to June 2027)
lineage.niche: a primary care network placing its clinical pharmacist's statin continuity sessions for January to June 2027 at one of seven general practices, read from the practices' repeat statin issue records, their repeat authorisations and the patient register
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many members of each group will have stopped by a date when a member keeps going only through a renewal reached after a fixed run of uses and nearly all stopping happens at a renewal; a curve on time since each member began, or any trailing rate, spreads those losses evenly and ranks the groups by their history, while running each member forward to its own next renewal shows that one group's members were all restarted together a year earlier, so their renewals fall inside the window.
lineage.driver_concrete: Statin repeats in the seven practices run on authorisations of a fixed number of issues, and nearly every patient who stops does so when the last issue is used and the repeat waits for a clinician to re-authorise it; Marrick House moved most of its stable repeat patients to 56-day issues in February and March 2026, re-authorising each repeat as six issues, so those repeats run out together in January and February 2027 and Marrick House has the most patients with no statin from March to June 2027 (170), while the persistence curve on time since starting, last year's same window and the trailing year's stops all put Cobbet Street first.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst fits each practice's persistence curve on months since starting the statin, carries each patient now on a statin forward on it and sends the pharmacist to Cobbet Street at about 83, whose six-issue repeats give it the steepest curve, with Marrick House last at 46; the losses sit at the end of each repeat authorisation, and Marrick House's spring 2026 move to 56-day issues re-authorised most of its patients' repeats at once, so they run out together before March 2027 and Marrick House has about 170 against Cobbet Street's 129.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-28 at the portal's second determinism return on the same fork (Gate C/D, competing_defensible_answer, golden_wrong): the per-patient chance's estimator was unpinned and a joint-outcome model fitted and validated on the 2024 and 2025 cohorts filed Cobbet Street then Fennbridge; the estimator was the decisive step, so filing it was rule application and a filed back-test handed the clock over; the call itself held on the portal (rubric 72 with the call held).
